description: Image Description: The image is of a black computer keyboard with a unique design. It features a standard QWERTY layout with additional keys on the sides. At the top center, there is a display screen with the text "WELCOME TO SECOND LIFE" and options labeled "BACK" and "ENTER." The keyboard has extra buttons, possibly for media control, on the left-hand side, and additional function keys on the right. The design includes ergonomic elements, with a curved shape and a wrist rest
